text: These photos were taken in the Hibiny Mountains near Kirovsk, Russia, beyond the Arctic Circle. The story was simple, but inspiring. A friend asked me to meet someone who had come here to become a snowboard trainer. He wanted to hike before winter arrived, which happens very quickly in this region. Autumn had already turned the landscape gold and red, with short trees, bushes, moss and rocks all around us. He brought his dog, and we headed up while the weather was still calm. I took my camera, hoping for the golden hour. Higher up, the little dog got tired, so we stopped and decided to head back. As storm clouds gathered, the golden hour finally appeared, revealing all the autumn colors. It lasted about twenty minutes before everything turned dark and stormy. We also found berries and mushrooms along the way. In short, it was a friendly hike with a beloved pet and a brief glimpse of sunset before the storm. @temprrly 📷 @photography
